tableInfo.name: 指示受け承認情報履歴
tableInfo.sqlForTool: select * from ( select PATID ,DIALYSIS_DATE ,PLURAL ,CHECK_CLASS ,REG_DATE ,nvl(TRIM(CHECK_STAFF_CD) ,'0') as CHECK_STAFF_CD ,nvl2( CHECK_STAFF_CD, '1', '0' ) as sign_type ,CHECK_STAFF_CD_UPDATE ,CHECK_STAFF_NAME ,CHECK_DATE ,TRIM(INPUT_STAFF_CD) AS INPUT_STAFF_CD ,INPUT_STAFF_NAME ,LEAD(TRIM(CHECK_STAFF_CD), 1, null ) OVER (PARTITION BY PATID,DIALYSIS_DATE,PLURAL,CHECK_CLASS ORDER BY REG_DATE desc ) AS BEF_CHECK_STAFF_CD from IND_RECEIVE WHERE DIALYSIS_DATE >= :START_DATE and DIALYSIS_DATE < :END_DATE {sqlForSync} and DEL_FLG='0' ORDER BY PATID,DIALYSIS_DATE,PLURAL, REG_DATE ) a LEFT JOIN SCH_DIALYSIS_PLAN plan on a.PATID||a.DIALYSIS_DATE||a.PLURAL = plan.IND_ID LEFT JOIN RST_DIALYSIS rst ON rst.DIALYSIS_NO = plan.RESULT_DIALYSISNO WHERE (plan.RESULT_DIALYSISNO is null or (rst.DIALYSIS_NO = plan.RESULT_DIALYSISNO and plan.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}')) {sqlForExclusiveOutputted}
